Container.Name: ONYX
Container.Overview:
ONYX — AI-powered Twitch VOD Highlight Analyzer. Automatically downloads Twitch VODs, detects kills, deaths and multikills using YOLO11 computer vision + Whisper AI, and cuts highlight clips — fully automated. Supports Battlefield 6, CS2, Apex Legends, Fortnite, Valorant, Warzone, PUBG, Overwatch 2 and more via customizable game profiles.
Features: Zero-Touch Pipeline (Download → Analyze → Cut → Compile → YouTube Upload → Notify), real-time event detection (YOLO11 fine-tuned + OCR + Whisper audio transcription), Discord/Telegram notifications, YouTube auto-upload (OAuth2), clip browser with timeline, A/B clip comparison, n8n/webhook integration, watermark + intro/outro branding, and a license-based SaaS model.
Try the demo: use key ONYX-1JL6-Z8W8-96HV on any ONYX instance (read-only showcase). Requires: NVIDIA GPU (CUDA), License Key from onyx-pro.de (from €9.99/month).
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: twitch vod highlight clip gaming ai whisper yolo11 battlefield bf6 cs2 apex valorant fortnite warzone streamer automation
Container.Requires: NVIDIA GPU with CUDA support. License Key required (onyx-pro.de).

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Port for the ONYX web interface.

Config.Name: Highlight Clips Output
Config.Description: Directory where ONYX saves the cut highlight clips.

Config.Name: VOD Download Cache
Config.Description: Directory for downloaded Twitch VODs. Keep on a fast drive — VODs can be 20–80 GB.

Config.Name: App Data (Database + Settings)
Config.Description: ONYX database, settings and runtime data. Keep on cache drive for speed.

Config.Name: AI Model Cache (Whisper + YOLO)
Config.Description: Whisper and YOLO model files. Persisted between updates (~3–8 GB). Keep on cache drive.

Config.Name: NVIDIA Visible Devices
Config.Description: Which GPUs are visible to the container. Use 'all' or a specific device index like '0'.

Config.Name: Memory Limit
Config.Description: RAM cap for ONYX. Whisper + YOLO + video decoding peaks at ~10-12 GB. Use 16g for 32 GB systems, 20g for 64 GB+, 10g for 16 GB.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Container timezone. Used for scheduled VOD downloads and log timestamps.

Config.Name: CUDA Memory Tuning
Config.Description: Prevents VRAM fragmentation during long VOD analysis. Lower to max_split_size_mb:256 on GPUs with less than 8 GB VRAM.

Config.Name: NVIDIA Driver Capabilities
Config.Description: NVIDIA capabilities passed to the container. Do not change.

Config.Name: glibc Malloc Trim Threshold
Config.Description: Aggressive heap return after Whisper/YOLO peak — frees RAM back to OS immediately.

Config.Name: glibc Malloc mmap Threshold
Config.Description: Large allocations via mmap so they are immediately freed after use.
